source: Advanced short story written in spoken Palestinian by Claude. NOT native-validated.

sentences.ar: بحارتنا، كان في جار فقير اسمه أبو علي.
sentences.en: In our neighborhood, there was a poor neighbor named Abu Ali.

sentences.ar: كان يشتغل نهار وليل عشان يطعم ولاده.
sentences.en: He worked day and night to feed his children.

sentences.ar: رغم فقره، كان دايما مبتسم وطيب.
sentences.en: Despite his poverty, he was always smiling and kind.

sentences.ar: مرة، مرض ولده وما كان معه مصاري للدوا.
sentences.en: Once, his child got sick and he had no money for medicine.

sentences.ar: كان محتار ومهموم، ما بيعرف شو يعمل.
sentences.en: He was confused and worried, not knowing what to do.
The people of the neighborhood heard the news.

sentences.ar: بدون ما يقول حدا، جمعوا مصاري بينهم.
sentences.en: Without anyone saying so, they collected money among themselves.

sentences.ar: حطوها بمغلف وحطوه تحت باب أبو علي.
sentences.en: They put it in an envelope and placed it under Abu Ali's door.

sentences.ar: الصبح، أبو علي لقى المغلف واستغرب.
sentences.en: In the morning, Abu Ali found the envelope and was surprised.
He took his child to the doctor and bought the medicine.

sentences.ar: الولد طاب، وأبو علي ما عرف مين ساعده.
sentences.en: The child recovered, and Abu Ali never knew who helped him.
He asked the neighbors, but no one admitted it.

sentences.ar: قال: الله يجازي اللي عمل هالخير.
sentences.en: He said: may God reward whoever did this good deed.

sentences.ar: من يومها، صار أبو علي يساعد كل محتاج.
sentences.en: From that day, Abu Ali started helping everyone in need.

sentences.ar: قال: الخير اللي وصلني، لازم أمرره لغيري.
sentences.en: He said: the good that reached me, I must pass on to others.
